source: Immutable Git-blob projection containing every changed file in each available head, merge-base, and base-tip role.
selectionRule: Complete changed-file list only; selected without using expected labels.
diff: Complete authoritative diff from frozen merge base to frozen review head.
changedFiles: Complete changed-file metadata for the frozen comparison.
pull: Frozen pull metadata produced by the repository review-bundle preparer.
feedback: Feedback retained by the repository review-bundle preparer at projection time.
limitation: Immutable changed-file projection for a supplied-candidate development regression. It is not a complete repository snapshot or a fresh-discovery evaluation.
